dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Identified multiple elliptical and circular structures in the mid-right quadrant; these exhibit high-contrast, light-gray perimeters (high-intensity) approximately 15-25 pixels wide surrounding low-intensity dark-gray cores, with soft gradient transitions at the external edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of amorphous light-gray pixel clusters is localized on the anterior (left-most) lateral region; these clusters lack internal gradients and appear as solid-tone, asymmetrical high-intensity concentrations against the dark base.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the central region form an obtuse scalene triangle; a secondary group of four high-intensity blobs creates a linear horizontal formation along the superior dorsal boundary.
